# Raul Primo

Portfolio: https://www.raulprimo.site
Canonical sitemap: https://www.raulprimo.site/sitemap.xml

Raul Primo is an AI Engineer and Software Engineer based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
He builds AI products, web applications, automation workflows, and data tools
with Next.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and applied AI systems.

Primary sections:
- Home and portfolio: https://www.raulprimo.site/

Representative work:

- Wings Group: health-focused deeptech products.
- SmartFIN: financial management tools for business owners.
- BeloPrato: menu and image tooling for restaurants.
- DigitalPubli: viral content insight tooling.
- AnalisaAI: spreadsheet and data analysis tooling.
- RepportAI: AI-powered reporting for sales teams.
